prompt: Chinese ancient Wuxia period movie still. Wide-angle shot, front view or slightly low angle, using a centripetal composition. In a dark void, billions of translucent golden energy-body spirit beasts roar and charge forward. The main subject is billions of spirit beasts composed of pure golden energy. They are translucent, their bodies seeming to have flowing light and energy cores inside. The beasts have varied forms, with recognizable silhouettes of dragons, qilins, phoenixes, giant tigers, and other mythical creatures. They have no physical substance but clear, powerful outlines. All the spirit beasts have their mouths wide open in a silent roar, their expressions fierce and full of fighting spirit. They form an unstoppable torrent, rushing fiercely from the depths of the frame towards the camera (the viewer). The few beasts in the very front are enormous and detailed, while those behind become progressively smaller and blurrier, creating a strong sense of depth. The scene is a dark void. The background is pure, deep darkness, without any stars or debris, which better accentuates the brightness and momentum of the golden beasts. Style is realistic (in the texture of the energy bodies), grand, shocking, full of power. The overall atmosphere: shocking, spectacular, unstoppable, and full of pressure. The golden torrent of billions of beasts gives a strong visual impact and a sense of awe, as if about to be engulfed. The only light source is the golden light emitted by the billions of beasts themselves. They illuminate each other and the void ahead. The beasts in the front are the brightest, with the light gradually diminishing towards the back, creating a magnificent layering of light and shadow. --ar 9:16
